# Grassroots Crisis Intervention

> 24/7 crisis intervention, mental health, and substance use disorder services serving Howard County and Central Maryland with free counseling, emergency shelter, and community support.

Grassroots Crisis Intervention is a Maryland-based nonprofit providing comprehensive crisis response and mental health services across Howard County. The organization operates multiple service centers including a 24-hour crisis line, walk-in crisis center, mobile crisis team, emergency shelter, and outpatient mental health clinic, with specialized support for military personnel and veterans.

## Crisis Services

- [Crisis Line](https://grassrootscrisis.org/crisis-line): 24-hour crisis line at 410-531-6677 or 988 with trained counselors
- [988 Crisis Chat & Text](https://grassrootscrisis.org/988-crisis): 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline chat and text support services
- [Walk-In Crisis Assistance](https://grassrootscrisis.org/walk-in-crisis): Walk-in crisis center at Columbia location for 24-hour counseling
- [Mobile Crisis Team](https://grassrootscrisis.org/mobile-crisis): Mobile Crisis Team provides onsite mental health emergency response

## Mental Health & Treatment Services

- [Services Overview](https://grassrootscrisis.org/services): Overview of free 24-hour crisis, mental health and substance use services
- [Outpatient Mental Health Clinic](https://grassrootscrisis.org/omhc): Free outpatient mental health clinic with therapy and medication management
- [Substance Use Disorder Services](https://grassrootscrisis.org/substance-use-disorder-services): Free 24-hour substance use disorder support and addiction treatment
- [Outreach and Prevention](https://grassrootscrisis.org/outreach): Community outreach, mental health trainings and suicide prevention programs

## Housing & Support Services

- [Emergency Shelter](https://grassrootscrisis.org/emergency-shelter): Howard County emergency shelter with 51 beds for families and individuals
- [Day Resource Center](https://grassrootscrisis.org/day-resource-center): Day Resource Center at Leola Dorsey in Jessup with meals and services

## Specialized Support

- [Military & Veteran Services](https://grassrootscrisis.org/military): Military and veteran-specific mental health and crisis support services

## Ways to Give

- [Donate](https://grassrootscrisis.org/donate): Main donation page for financial contributions to Grassroots Crisis
- [Money Donations](https://grassrootscrisis.org/donate-money): Financial donation options including PayPal and United Way giving
- [Monthly Giving](https://grassrootscrisis.org/monthly-giving): Monthly recurring donation program for Friends of Grassroots members
- [Donate Goods](https://grassrootscrisis.org/donate-goods): Donate hygiene and food items for Grassroots pantry and shelter
- [Donate Gift Cards](https://grassrootscrisis.org/donate-gift-cards): Donate grocery and retail gift cards to help individuals in need
- [Friends of Grassroots](https://grassrootscrisis.org/friends-of-grassroots): Membership program for $600 annual donors supporting crisis services

## Get Involved & Professional Resources

- [How to Help](https://grassrootscrisis.org/help): Volunteer opportunities and ways to support Grassroots Crisis services
- [For Providers](https://grassrootscrisis.org/for-providers): Resources and referral information for Maryland healthcare providers
